body: U+0023# Review fixes applied to #208 and #209U+000AU+000AU+0023## #208: code review found 3 medium, 6 low, none blockingU+000AFixed in commit 04b0843 (signed, pushed):U+000AU+002D **Clipped nodes.** A clipped node is judged at its full size when more than half of it is visible.U+000AU+002D **Phone tool:**U+000A  U+002D It skips only the clipped axis, so Today (42.7 dp wide) is judged again.U+000A  U+002D It ignores an EditText's text for repeats.U+000AU+002D **New states.** a11 proves `calendarThisWeekKey`, and d15 proves "2 of 3".U+000AU+002D **Tabs.** The tab stateful finder expects 4 tabs. There are four `tab-*` keys; New entry is the capture button.U+000AU+002D **Next month tap.** a11 taps Next month through a widget finder.U+000AU+002D **Guard tests.** They pin nodes that several render objects share, or that none owns.U+000AU+002D **Order dependence.** It is documented in the PR description.U+000AU+000AChecks: full suite 3,065 pass; write mode leaves the baselines unchanged. The d10 phone and widget screen mismatch (L9) is left for the report pairing.U+000AU+000AU+0023## #209: code review found 1 blocking, 3 medium, 4 minorU+000AFirst, #208 was merged into the branch (7b4790f). Then fixed in 3aeb509 (signed, pushed):U+000AU+002D **Blocking: hidden pill.** It took the card's taps, because the MouseRegion was outside the IgnorePointer. IgnorePointer now wraps the whole overlay, and the reveal pill grows its tap area downward (`growDown`).U+000AU+002D **Calendar chevrons.** The slots are right-aligned, so Next month stays in place and Previous month moves 8 dp, the minimum.U+000AU+002D **Day sheet header.** Its padding was trimmed, so the chip stays at (18, 19), the title at (64, 35), and the height at 73.5.U+000AU+002D **Top bar.** Padding changed to fromLTRB(16, 4, 4, 4); the gear and title are unchanged.U+000AU+002D **Numbered to-dos.** A to-do in a numbered list no longer leaves "2.".U+000AU+002D **Tests.** Five new tests, each proven red without its fix: pill hit, chevron position, header position, gear position, numbered to-do.U+000AU+000AChecks: full suite 3,108 pass, analyze clean, 30 goldens pass.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Rejected approach.** A shared `TapReach` was tried and reverted: Flutter rejects a hit outside a parent's bounds, so its reach outside the parent box would be fake compliance.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Accepted trade-offs**, written into the #209 description:U+000AU+002D the Add a note bar is 14 dp taller;U+000AU+002D a tap just below an open caption keeps editing, and the photo toolbar sits 13 dp lower;U+000AU+002D the sync fields read their row title twice, as a labelled field does.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Follow-upU+000ATo-do tap areas overlap: 48 dp targets 26 dp apart, from the #204 fix. Offered as a separate task.
